explanation: For λ>0, y=A cos(3λx)+B sin(3λx). The condition y(0)=0 gives A=0, and a nonzero solution requires sin(3λπ)=0, so λₙ=n/3 for n=1,2,… . The eigenfunctions are Bₙ sin(3λₙx), with Bₙ≠0. At λ=0 only the zero solution satisfies both boundaries. This tests eigenvalues of an ordinary differential-equation boundary value problem, absent from the supplied course topics, so it is prerequisite.
